description: This file defines a Java interface 'DevOpsCommandResponse' that serves as a base interface for responses to devops commands within a larger software system. It specifies methods for accessing service-related metadata and includes nested classes defining JSON field structure.

classes.name: DevOpsCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface defining the structure for DevOps command response objects, including methods for retrieving service metadata and a nested class for JSON field definitions.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Method to set Ditto headers for the response object.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with DevOps commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path, defaulting to empty for DevOps commands.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the service from which the response originated, if available.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the instance identifier of the originating service, if available.
